source_title: UNESCO World Trends Report in Data
direct_observation: freedom of expression and alternative sources declined roughly 10% since 2012, including pressure on academic and cultural expression
evidence_status: medium-to-high global signal; index cannot identify individual exposure
next_test: link country trend to named campus, discipline, decision and remedy

direct_observation: almost 40% of countries do not recognize higher-education institutional autonomy by law
evidence_status: high for legal baseline; autonomy in practice and individual protection remain open
next_test: compare legal autonomy with budgets, appointments, curriculum and appeals

direct_observation: revision responds to digital transformation, geopolitical tension, inequality, climate, demographic change and pressure on academic freedom and working conditions
evidence_status: high for policy agenda; revision is not implementation evidence
next_test: track adoption, national implementation and named personnel outcomes

direct_observation: non-binding framework covers academic freedom, institutional autonomy, employment conditions, professional development and social protection
evidence_status: high for normative scope; enforceability and remedy remain open
next_test: test institutional policy, employment protection, student voice and grievance results

direct_observation: four connected pillars are teaching, discussion/debate, research and dissemination, including intramural and public expression
evidence_status: high for rights definition; local safety and output quality remain open
next_test: follow one named case through exposure, response, publication/teaching and career effect

source_title: UNESCO education monitoring and data-gap evidence
direct_observation: administrative data and curated pilots can give incomplete or non-scalable pictures of access, learning and innovation
evidence_status: medium-to-high for measurement caution; local causal closure remains open
next_test: combine administrative, survey, qualitative and outcome data in one institution/community
